name: Can my existing foundation support a second-story addition?

mainEntity.name: Can my existing foundation support a second-story addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Assessing whether your existing foundation can support a second-story addition is a critical first step. This requires a professional structural engineer to evaluate your current foundation's capacity. They will inspect the original construction, soil conditions, and overall integrity to determine if it can safely bear the additional weight. In many cases, foundations may need to be reinforced or modified to meet current building codes and ensure stability for the new level. This structural assessment is essential for both safety and code compliance.
acceptedAnswer.description: A structural engineer must assess your existing foundation to determine if it can support a second story. Reinforcements may be necessary for safety and code compliance.
